_note: Item cards drawn from the item deck. Pokeball deck is separate. `value` = CPU trade fairness weight; `price` = shop BUY price (sell price is half).

items.name: Rare Candy
items.description: Evolve one Pokemon (or +25% boost, then +50% for 3). Use as many in a row as you like.

items.name: Revive
items.description: Revive a fainted Pokemon to half HP.

items.name: X-Attack
items.description: Lead Pokemon in next battle gets +25% Attack for 3 moves. Stackable.

items.name: X-Defense
items.description: Lead Pokemon in next battle gets +25% Defense for 3 incoming hits. Stackable.

items.name: Max Revive
items.description: Revive a fainted Pokemon to full HP.

items.name: Lucky Egg
items.description: 2x rewards from the NEXT gym leader you defeat. Consumed on use.

items.name: Egg
items.description: A mysterious Egg. Hatches into a SHINY Pokemon after 5 of your turns.
